_doc: Positions of the dock board's small parts (KiCad mm, y down, degrees), inside the parts area of dock-pcb/geometry.json (scripts/dock/place.py checks it). The pins, J1 and the screw holes come from geometry.json, not from here. "labels" places the designators that show (the connector and the LED); every other designator is hidden.

F1.why: pin 1 (VBUS) under J1's A9, pin 2 (DOCK_5V) toward the TVS

D1.why: right after the fuse: cathode on DOCK_5V, anode to GND

R1.why: CC1 pull-down, beside J1's CC pins

LED1.why: power LED, between the pockets where it shows

R3.why: LED resistor, its silkscreen clear of the LED's
